title: Remote runner cannot read its relay mailbox after a context recovery (404 via tool, 410 readKeyExpired via CLI)
outcome: After a context recovery, a remote runner session can still read its relay mailbox with the Integration owner through a supported, documented route. A stale read key is refused with an instruction that names the working fresh-read call, and the MCP tool resolves the relay mailbox it lists.
acceptance: Remote runner cannot read its relay mailbox after a context recovery (404 via tool, 410 readKeyExpired via CLI) is done
